advisory_id.description: Must exactly match an advisory_id from .ai-pr-analyzer/dependency-audit-advisories.json

package.description: Must exactly match the package name for that advisory_id

target.description: For bump-dependency/add-resolution: the version or semver range to pin `package` to (e.g. '^4.17.21'). For remove-resolution: the exact key currently in package.json's resolutions to delete. Empty string for no-safe-fix.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences explaining the decision
Summary of what was investigated across all advisories
